bias.en: Turning bullish · pressing the Oct 12 high
bias.zh: 转为偏多 · 挑战 10 月 12 日高点

read.en: Amazon edged up 0.1% on Oct 20 to $262.63, holding the previous day's 5.0% jump, between $260.42 and $265.34. It is above the 5-day ($256.8), rising 10-day ($257.8), falling 30-day ($253.5) and 100-day ($252.1) and rising 200-day ($243.1) averages. MACD has been above its signal since Oct 5 and above zero, with the histogram widening; Parabolic SAR has been bullish since Oct 19 ($248.6), and RSI is 57.
read.zh: 亚马逊 10月20日微涨 0.1%，收于 $262.63，守住前一日 5.0% 的涨幅，盘中区间 $260.42–265.34。股价位于 5 日（$256.8）、上行的 10 日（$257.8）、下行的 30 日（$253.5）和 100 日（$252.1）及上行的 200 日均线（$243.1）上方。MACD 自 10月5日起位于信号线及零轴上方，柱状图扩大；抛物线 SAR 自 10月19日起看多（$248.6），RSI 为 57。

read.en: The high pushed above the $263.7 Oct 12 high, but the close stayed just under it, so no level changed. Resistance is $263.7–265.3, then $267.6 (Aug 28 high) and $278.6 (May 5 high). Support is $256.8–257.8 (5 and 10-day), then $252–253.5 (30 and 100-day) and $248.6 (Oct 15–16 lows, SAR). A close above $265.3 would open $267.6, then $278.6.
